# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

We want this project to be a welcoming and respectful place for everyone,
regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression,
experience level, nationality, appearance, religion, or sexual orientation.

Everyone participating in the project is expected to follow this code of conduct.

## Expected Behavior

- Treat others with respect and empathy.
- Give constructive feedback focused on the work.
- Accept feedback and take responsibility for mistakes.
- Respect different viewpoints, backgrounds, and levels of experience.
- Respect other people's privacy and boundaries.
- Keep discussions relevant and help others participate.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, discrimination, threats, or intimidation.
- Personal attacks, insults, or deliberately disruptive behavior.
- Sexual harassment, sexualized content, or unwanted sexual attention.
- Publishing another person's private information without permission.
- Retaliation against someone for reporting a concern or participating in an investigation.
- Continuing unwanted contact after being asked to stop.

Respectful technical disagreement is welcome. It must not become a personal attack.

## Scope

This policy applies to project issues, pull requests, code reviews, discussions,
and other community spaces maintained by the project. It also applies when
someone publicly represents the project.

## Reporting Concerns

Report violations privately to the project maintainer at:

[matheusterzini@gmail.com](mailto:matheusterzini@gmail.com)

Include a description of what happened, relevant links or evidence, and any
immediate concerns. Do not publish private details in a public issue or pull request.

Reports will be handled as discreetly as possible. Information may be shared
with those who need it to investigate or respond; absolute confidentiality
cannot be guaranteed. There is no guaranteed response timeframe.

## Enforcement

The maintainer is responsible for reviewing reports fairly, considering the
context and severity of the behavior, and communicating appropriate actions.

Actions may include requesting a correction, issuing a warning, removing
content, or temporarily or permanently restricting participation. Serious
violations may result in immediate restrictions.

Anyone involved in a report should avoid handling a complaint about their own
behavior. Where possible, another uninvolved maintainer should review it.
